summary: Members can agree on whom to endorse and still disagree about giving every campaign the same amount.
realLife: The Mojave Desert club discussed equal contributions for its endorsed candidates and instead took a separate vote on money for Muller-Lopez’s campaign (May 26, 2018).
inGame: needs: the endorsements, proposed allocations and the vote on each payment.

turns.what: The chair takes that motion on its own.
turns.pulledBy: A member asks for a vote on one candidate’s contribution.
turns.writesBack: The treasurer has an amount tied to a named vote.

turns.what: The treasurer calculates the total against the available funds.
turns.pulledBy: Members adopt equal amounts for the eligible campaigns.
turns.writesBack: The minutes specify who qualifies for equal treatment.
